title: Reginald Endicott Barclay III's Resume
summary: Innovative Starfleet engineer with extensive experience in starship computer systems, holodeck programming, and advanced subspace research. Known for solving complex technical problems under pressure and pioneering unconventional approaches to interstellar communication and simulation technologies. Proven contributor to engineering teams aboard Galaxy-class starships and within Starfleet research divisions.

bullets: Conducted system diagnostics and maintenance across Galaxy-class starship computer cores and engineering subsystems.
Developed enhanced diagnostic protocols that reduced warp core troubleshooting time by 27%.
Designed holodeck simulation programs used for crew training, psychological wellness, and tactical scenario modeling.
Collaborated with senior engineering staff to identify and resolve emergent anomalies within shipwide computer networks.
Led technical investigation into a holodeck system malfunction, ultimately identifying a self-aware simulation construct and restoring system integrity.
Maintained and programmed holodeck environments used for training simulations and mission planning.
Implemented safeguards for holographic behavioral modeling to prevent runaway AI routines.
Partnered with medical and counseling staff to create therapeutic simulation environments for crew rehabilitation.
Assisted in developing experimental subspace signal amplification methods capable of reaching vessels in distant quadrants.
Contributed to breakthrough theoretical work enabling communication with the USS Voyager during its displacement in the Delta Quadrant.
Designed simulation models predicting long-range subspace signal degradation and relay optimization.
